auth.title: Wallet sign-in required
auth.description: Please connect your wallet and sign the message to access your personalized dashboard and rewards.

pendingPlacements.title: Pending Placements
pendingPlacements.description: {count} {count, plural, one {user waiting} other {users waiting}} for tree placement

summary.note: Pending members should be placed into an open LEFT or RIGHT slot inside the subtree.

legend.title: Placement Legend
legend.description: The tree stays binary. Direct referrals and deeper subtree members use different visual cues, and pending members can be dragged or tapped into any open subtree slot.

tree.title: Tree Snapshot
tree.description: Compact subtree view for placement decisions. Tap nodes for details, focus visible subtrees to go deeper, expand branches on demand, and place pending members into any open subtree slot.
tree.snapshotUnavailableDescription: Reconnect and refresh after your latest placement changes.
tree.viewingRoot: Viewing your current subtree root. Open a node card and focus it to continue deeper.

hints.inspect: Tap a node to inspect details
hints.focus: Open a node, then focus its subtree to go deeper
hints.expand: Expand only the branches you need
hints.drag: Drag a pending member onto a glowing slot or tap-select it first

tree.emptyDescription: No nodes were returned for this subtree yet.

share.title: Share Center
share.codeDescription: Share this code or the full referral link below
share.qrDescription: Scanning this code opens your referral link with the invite code embedded.
share.openQrAria: Open referral QR code in a new tab
share.awaitingPlacementTitle: Share unlocks after your own placement
share.awaitingPlacementDescription: Your inviter binding is already saved. Once your upstream places you into the tree, your own invite code, referral link, and QR code will unlock automatically.
share.awaitingBindingDescription: Users who first arrive through a referral link bind automatically. If you entered directly, bind an inviter below first. Your own invite code, referral link, and QR code will appear after you are both bound and placed into the tree.

pending.title: Pending Placements
pending.emptyDescription: Newly joined referrals waiting for placement will appear here.

confirmation.title: Placement Confirmation
confirmation.instructionsDragging: Drop the pending member onto any glowing LEFT or RIGHT slot, then confirm the final placement.
confirmation.instructionsSelected: Choose a glowing LEFT or RIGHT slot in the tree. The summary below will update before you confirm.
confirmation.instructionsIdle: Select a pending member first, then choose a subtree slot.
confirmation.slotDescription: This keeps referral and placement semantics intact: direct referral remains unchanged, while the subtree parent and side define the actual binary-tree mount.
confirmation.selectSlotHint: Tap or drop onto an arrow slot in the tree above to choose the target.

hero.checkedToday: You can still check in today

direct.description: Tap the red circle above to send 3 USDT directly from your wallet. After the transfer confirms, the page will automatically submit the tx hash to complete today's check-in.
direct.checkedTodayNotice: You already checked in today. Additional same-day check-ins are still allowed, but they do not increase consecutive days.
direct.walletWarning: Connect wallet, sign in, and switch to chain {chainId} to use direct check-in.

manual.title: Manual recovery
manual.description: If you already sent 3 USDT but automatic submission failed, paste the tx hash here to recover this check-in.

errors.transferDescription: The USDT transfer was not confirmed. If you already sent it from another wallet window, use manual recovery below.
